alt_fr: Portrait masculin sculpté surmonté d’un dôme torsadé
alt_en: Carved male portrait topped by a twisted dome
description_fr: Un dôme surmonte ce portrait masculin. La torsade suit la courbe du volume et donne du mouvement à une coiffure dont la forme reste ample et arrondie.
description_en: A dome crowns this male portrait. The twist follows the curve of the volume and gives movement to a hairstyle whose form remains full and rounded.
